name: CohFrictMatSeg
description: Material extending CohFrictMat to use dual material properties with segmented bodies (transition between properties depends on the coating thickness). Should be used with Ip2_CohFrictMatSeg_CohFrictMatSeg_CohFrictPhys to benefit from dual material capabilites. The other functors can be the same as...

attributes.name: alphaKr
attributes.description: Dimensionless rolling stiffness.

attributes.name: alphaKtw
attributes.description: Dimensionless twist stiffness.

attributes.name: density
attributes.description: Density of the material [kg/m³]

attributes.name: etaRoll
attributes.description: Dimensionless rolling (aka 'bending') strength. If negative, rolling moment will be elastic.

attributes.name: etaTwist
attributes.description: Dimensionless twisting strength. If negative, twist moment will be elastic.

attributes.name: fragile
attributes.description: does cohesion disappear when contact strength is exceeded?

attributes.name: frictionAngle
attributes.description: Contact friction angle (in radians). Hint : use 'radians(degreesValue)' in python scripts.

attributes.name: isCohesive
attributes.description: Whether this body can form possibly cohesive interactions (if true and depending on other parameters such as

attributes.name: maxThickness
attributes.description: Value of thickness parameter, above which only secondary material parameters are taken into account.

attributes.name: minThickness
attributes.description: Value of thickness parameter, below which only primary material parameters are taken into account.

attributes.name: momentRotationLaw
attributes.description: Use bending/twisting moment at contact. The contact may have moments only if both bodies have this flag true. See

attributes.name: normalCohesion
attributes.description: Tensile strength, homogeneous to a pressure. If negative the normal force is purely elastic.

attributes.name: poisson
attributes.description: Poisson's ratio or the ratio between shear and normal stiffness [-]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: secondaryFrictionAngle
attributes.description: Friction angle (secondary).

attributes.name: secondaryNormalCohesion
attributes.description: Tensile strength (secondary), homogeneous to a pressure. If negative the normal force is purely elastic.

attributes.name: secondaryPoisson
attributes.description: Poisson's ratio (secondary) or the ratio between shear and normal stiffness [-]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: secondaryShearCohesion
attributes.description: Shear strength (secondary), homogeneous to a pressure. If negative the shear force is purely elastic.

attributes.name: secondaryYoung
attributes.description: elastic modulus (secondary) [Pa]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: shearCohesion
attributes.description: Shear strength, homogeneous to a pressure. If negative the shear force is purely elastic.

attributes.name: young
attributes.description: elastic modulus [Pa]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.
